message: May Lord Shiva and Parvati shower both of you with eternal harmony, deep love, and prosperous years together. God bless you, Pooja and Deepak!
So incredibly happy for both of you! Looking forward to joining you in Kaushambi and celebrating your Sangeet night!
Wishing Deepak and Pooja a lifetime of togetherness, laughter, and endless happiness. Counting down to the grand celebration on 24th November!
